qualities.note: Game-design value chosen for plausible behaviour; tune in the sim labs. Morale (owner 2026-11-15, by quality never by nationality): resolve = ceiling of a fresh man's morale; pinSuppression = suppression that pins him; recovery = factor on recovery; bond = default squad cohesion; fatigueCost = resolve lost per unit of fatigue above 0.4.
